## Review summary
The combined recipe set has clear task boundaries and passes deterministic checks, but two cross-recipe routing defects need correction before merge; the parent description also still describes scaffolds. AEO improvements should make existing answers self-contained rather than broaden the recipes or add keyword-heavy pages. Found: 2 critical, 1 important, 6 suggestions, 0 nits; recommendation: Request changes.

## PR-level finding
[IMPORTANT] Refresh the parent description before main-branch review. It still says this PR adds six buildable guide scaffolds and asks reviewers to confirm independent scaffold diffs, but the current diff contains all six complete recipes, the overview, and navigation. Update the summary, design scope, human review focus, and verification limitations for the combined set. Record the actual AEO source signals and page ownership rather than claiming all six topics have measured search demand. Keep engineering-review-required risk; a syntax/build pass is not a live workflow or deployment check.

## Editorial verdict
Keep the six existing-factory recipes and their distinct outputs. Triage owns investigation; implementation owns approved fixes; review owns findings; incident intake owns a read-only report; UI verification owns observed evidence; SDLC owns the connected handoff. Preserve same-PR continuity, human approvals, provider differences, credential boundaries, and verifier evidence/staleness rules. Remove repeated table framing and clarify long skill/configuration steps rather than cutting necessary teaching. No claim of automatic deployment, monitoring, cross-factory orchestration, or migration is added.

## AEO brief
**Goal:** Make these existing recipes useful, attributable answers to practical software-factory workflow questions.
**Recommendation:** Update this set and its existing overview; no new pages, FAQs, or title overhaul.
**Source signals (Peec, 2026-09-28 through 2026-10-27):** 'what does a complete software factory workflow look like' (Low volume bucket); 'how to integrate AI coding agents into a software factory workflow' (High); 'what's the best way to review code changes that an AI agent made?' (High). The owned how-to recommendation calls for practical 'how to build a software factory' content. That broader setup intent belongs with existing overview/quickstart owners, not in every recipe.
**Vocabulary map:** Software-factory and agentic SDLC queries map to the existing connected-workflow recipe; reviewing agent-written changes maps to pull request review. Browser/preview access is adjacent to, not identical to, automated UI verification. Introduce Warp Factories once in each standalone opening while retaining precise task vocabulary.
**Content scope:** Include triggers, outputs, stopping points, human gates, named provider boundaries, and real examples. Avoid keyword stuffing, comparisons, duplicate setup guides, and unsupported end-to-end claims.
**Existing owners:** The use-case overview chooses tasks; the recipes show bounded configurations; factory quickstart owns first setup, lifecycle docs own default behavior, and provider references own exhaustive filters.
**Open questions/limits:** HYC's original per-article query brief is not in the PR. Searches found no active or archived incident/triage prompts; that does not prove a lack of demand. No citation lift or post-publication ranking effect was measured.

## Validation and evidence
- Seven public pages, six cards, and seven sidebar routes checked.
- 114 internal links passed; all six recipe compression checks passed.
- All seven descriptions are within 50-160 characters.
- No actionable deterministic style errors; glossary warnings require context rather than renaming shipped UI or generic list labels.
- Structural PR contract passed with zero VERIFY markers; engineering-review-required classification is appropriate.
- Typecheck passed with zero errors; five heading-variable tests passed.
- Build, generated heading/TOC check, and homepage JSON-LD check passed.
- Relevant rollout checks found no matched production-off gate at the source revision; no live provider, factory, or Computer Use workflow was exercised.
- Evaluated parent head `75e79f2938ca7cf0e5db807e8696b5b35ae62179` and supporting warp-server source `27c9fb8049c27037c15833ab711f7b7a131bf6ac`; source and checked-in configuration are not deployment evidence.
- No documentation content was edited, committed, or pushed during this review. The clean parent worktree was fast-forwarded to the evaluated remote head.

## Verdict
Request changes. Published as a non-blocking comment review.
